mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous CPIAUCSL index level above 260 and FEDFUNDS rate below 0.1% signals a policy response to elevated inflation, compressing real rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 260), a decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing response that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units over the past two months signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 142 million and a drop in retail sales (RSAFS) below 550 billion signals a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP level regime (GDPC1 > 18000), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a cooling in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500 and GDPC1 > 18000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
